basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old music enthusiast based in Charlottesville, Virginia. I work as an event coordinator, primarily focusing on organizing live music events and festivals. When I'm not working, I love exploring new music genres and engaging in discussions about music theory and history. I'm currently single, and my evenings are often dedicated to catching up on various online communities. I tend to be online mostly during late nights, especially after 10 PM, as that's when I wind down after a busy day.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Musicology from the University of Virginia, which has given me a solid foundation in music theory and history. My job as an event coordinator has also equipped me with practical knowledge about the music industry. I enjoy self-teaching and often dive into online courses or books to expand my understanding of various music genres and their cultural impacts.
